text:
The response provides only a superficial, generic list that could apply to many cultures and misses the most distinctive and critical aspects of Japanese business culture. Notably, the advice to "avoid direct eye contact" is misleading—modern Japanese business etiquette actually expects appropriate eye contact (avoiding only prolonged staring), and following this advice could make a foreigner seem evasive or untrustworthy. The answer also omits essential practices such as the business card exchange ritual (*meishi kōkan*), bowing protocols, gift-giving customs, the importance of consensus-building (*nemawashi*), seating arrangements, and group harmony (*wa*). Without context or practical guidance on how to apply these norms, the response offers limited actionable value for someone preparing for actual business interactions in Japan.

Rating: [[4]]
